verdict.rationale: Pipedrive has a first-party MCP server feature page, confirmed by a probe, stating that an AI assistant can find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through the pipeline and automate workflows. That clearly delivers the core of connecting an agent via an official MCP server. The evidence is limited to a marketing-level description. missing for 10: connection/setup and authentication documentation, a detailed tool catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
